SELECT lookup.security_code , ips.target_pool_id , ips.security_type
, al.id AS entry_log_id , COALESCE(ips.entry_time, al.audit_time, ips.crte_time) AS entry_time
FROM (
SELECT CONCAT(#{code}, '') AS security_code
) lookup INNER JOIN ip_pool_status ips ON ips.security_code = lookup.security_code
LEFT JOIN ip_adjust_log al ON al.id = ips.adjust_log_id AND ips.target_pool_id IN
#{poolId}
WHERE ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY ips.id ASC
